verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general appearance configurability: a "mind-boggling number of options", 24-bit and 256-color support, and Smart Cursor Color and Minimum Contrast features. Automatic profile switching exists, but it is triggered by hostname, username or directory, not by system appearance. Missing for 10: explicit color scheme or theme presets and import, automatic light/dark mode switching, any independent or hands-on corroboration of theming.
